X.note: The dark stage with glossy cubes looks decent. The labels cover the cubes and each other. The 13% card is semi-transparent and its text sits over the 6% card's edge and the green cube, so it's low-contrast and hard to read. The cubes are almost the same height even though the values are 7%, 6% and 13%, so the visual is dishonest. 'ACTUAL' is repeated in every badge, which is noise. The three labels don't clearly map to their cubes. The caption and source lines are legible.

Y.note: The terrain is attractive and the lighting and shadows are good. The tooltip has strong contrast and the caption is clean. The scene is sparse. A single tiny cube and a small document icon sit on a map with no place labels, so the viewer can't tell where this is. A big teal shape is cut off at the left edge. '~5 ships/yr' shows a quantity with no comparison. The document icon isn't tied to the 'Construction Differential Subsidy' caption. The viewer has to guess what the cube and the document mean.

why: Y's text is clean and readable, while X's overlapping, semi-transparent labels hide the numbers and its cube heights don't match the values.
top_fix_for_weaker: Space the three callouts apart so none overlap, make the 13% card opaque with the same contrast as the others, scale the cube heights to 7/6/13, and drop the repeated 'ACTUAL' badges.
